metadata.description: IT & Systems Engineering skill pack for Claude Code

plugins.name: it-sys-eng-skills
plugins.description: 24 IT & Systems Engineering skills: infrastructure (Terraform, Kubernetes), cloud (AWS/Azure/GCP), DevOps and SRE, identity and Joiner/Mover/Leaver (Okta), endpoint management (Intune for Windows, Kandji for Mac), Google Workspace (GAM), Apps Script automation, Jira Service Management, PowerShell/M365 admin, databases (PostgreSQL, SQL), observability, incident response, and code/security review.
